_about: Tissue values for the body's walking simulations (tools/body_walk.py). Muscle, fat and skin are Rafael's rafa8 values from the thigh; the cavity (organs) is declared by eye. Edit to change; a run can override one as NAME=value. Units: Pa, kg/m3, 1/s, steps per frame. REGIONS overrides by tissue and zone, {tissue: {zone: {young, density, poisson, damping}}}; empty means the defaults everywhere.
_source: rafa8 (2026-11-07) for SUBSTEPS to POISSON; CAVITY_* declared 2026-11-07; GLAND_YOUNG and GLAND_DAMPING from PRESETS["breast"] in blender/muscle_sphere.py (LIQUID 2000 and DAMPER 50, as the closest values it has), GLAND_DENSITY declared 1040; VISCERA_* start as the cavity's, so nothing changes until they are tuned; FAT_DEEP_* start as the fat's, so the two layers move alike until tuned; BALLOON_* declared 2026-11-09: water's density, and a very soft inside, since the balloon's volume is held by one constraint per balloon, not by its tetrahedra
